'''Chris Wodicka''' (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''Wedge231''')<ref name="dt-23830">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830 6th place Coruscant regionals], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23830/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23830/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009115058/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830/ Wayback Machine].</ref> finished 6th of 36 at [[2002 Coruscant Regionals]] with a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list. He went 2-1 with it at the [[2002 NYC Mini-Open]].<ref name="dt-23830" /> He published constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]].
